disclaimer: Unofficial guide compiled from public sources. Not affiliated with Vento or Wave by Vento. Always double-check on the official website and app.

event.name: Wave by Vento 2026
event.organizer: Vento (Vento Ventures), Italian early-stage venture fund
event.description: One of Europe's leading tech conferences: a yearly gathering in Turin for founders, investors and tech leaders.

venue.name: OGR Torino (Officine Grandi Riparazioni)
venue.description: Late-19th-century former railway workshops turned into a cultural and innovation hub.
venue.event_area: The event space is entirely on the ground floor, from the OGR Cult wing to the outdoor area and the Snodo bar.

items.name: Masterclass studios
items.notes: Educational sessions of 45-90 minutes, up to about 50 seats each. Seats must be reserved in the official app.

items.name: Live podcasts
items.notes: 11+ live podcast recordings with international tech voices. Bookable in the official app.

items.name: Tech Expo
items.notes: Exhibition area included in every pass.

items.name: Investor lounge
items.notes: Dedicated lounge for VCs, angels, family offices and corporate venture arms.

getting_there.metro: Metro line M1, Vinzaglio stop: about 10 minutes on foot.
getting_there.train: Torino Porta Susa railway station: about 10 minutes on foot.
getting_there.tram_bus: Tram 9 and buses 12, 33, 58 and 68 stop at Inghilterra.
parking: Parcheggio Nino Bixio, Via Nino Bixio 46
Parcheggio Palagiustizia, Corso Vittorio Emanuele II

categories.name: Startup
categories.for: Founders and startup teams, from pre-seed to growth stage.

categories.name: Investor
categories.for: VCs, angels, family offices, CVCs and operators. Includes the attending-startups database and the investor lounge.

passes.included_in_every_pass: 3-day access, all sessions on both stages, masterclasses (seat booking in the app), live podcasts, the Tech Expo and all common areas.
passes.free_access: Students and accredited press (journalists covering technology and innovation; request via the press form) get free passes.
discounts: 15% discount for members of the Piedmont innovation hubs (Poli di Innovazione).
Camera di commercio di Torino: 15% discount for up to 70 companies from the Turin area.
passes.pricing_note: 2026 is the first edition with paid passes. Early-bird prices ended on 31 August 2026: check current prices on the official pass page.

access.entry: Bring the pass QR code from My Area (linked in the purchase confirmation email; it can be saved to your phone wallet) and an identity document, which is checked at the entrance.
access.badge: Print your badge with the same QR code at the dedicated kiosks at OGR Torino, from a few days before the event and during the event days. Exact days and times are sent by email.

official_app.name: Wave by Vento (built on Brella)
official_app.availability: App Store and Google Play. Reserved to passholders.
features: Profile and AI-powered matchmaking with other attendees
Booking masterclasses (limited seats) and live podcasts

on_site.accessibility: Fully accessible: everything is on the ground floor, with step-free entrances, elevators and accessible restrooms.
on_site.food: Indoor bar and buffet restaurant, plus street-food trucks in the outdoor courtyard. Gluten-free, vegan and vegetarian options available.
on_site.cloakroom: Cloakroom for coats and small items at the entrance of Binario 3.
on_site.luggage: Trolleys and large bags can be left in the storage rooms at Fondazione Time2, just across the street from OGR (08:30-20:00).

side_events.summary: 90+ off-site events organised independently by tech communities across Turin during Wave week.
side_events.registration: Register on each event's Luma page. Some side events require the organiser's approval.
side_events.hosting: To host a side event, submit it through the Luma calendar or write to wave@vento.ventures.

closing_party.name: .WAV
closing_party.summary: Official closing party of Wave by Vento: electronic music, digital art and architecture at OGR Torino.
closing_party.producers: Produced by Wave and Piano B, curated by Recall (Turin electronic-music collective).
